prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A solitary man sits slumped on the bare floor of a stark, empty prison cell, viewed through thick, white-painted metal bars that dominate the foreground and create a sense of separation and confinement. The man wears dark, loose-fitting prison clothes and simple shoes, his posture weary and defeated, with his back against the wall and legs stretched out in front of him. His expression is somber and introspective, conveying a deep sense of isolation and resignation. The cell is minimalistic, with pale, almost clinical off-white walls and a single, plain bed built into the right side of the frame. The lighting is soft and diffuse, casting gentle shadows that emphasize the bleakness and emptiness of the space. The composition uses a high, slightly off-center camera angle, enhancing the feeling of surveillance and entrapment, while the muted color palette of grays, whites, and browns reinforces the somber, oppressive mood. The overall style is realistic and unembellished, evoking a sense of psychological drama and emotional weight.
